Title: Vihaan's Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 37 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 39 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Riya - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Vihaan stands on the road. Kavita and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "Today feels like a good day."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Vihaan sits in the back seat.]

Vihaan (happily): "Exactly right."

[Vihaan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Vihaan: "This is amazing!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Vihaan in the back.]

Vihaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
